items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Earl Jackson on the alto, and William Scott. We were all in Oliver Todd's band.

ctx.x: : Earl Jackson on the alto, and William Scott. We were all in Oliver Todd's band. And instead of usin' a drummer in Oliver Todd's band, we had a guy who would sing with the band sometime. That was Bill Nolan. And we put Countess on the thing--
: Bill Nolan -- he went with McShann too Chantue (phonetic), didn't he?
